item.title: Geoff Pitt is heading down “The Long Road”
item.description: Meet the passionate Blue's devotee Geoff Pitt - one half of the team who bring you "Greg Wilder's The Long Road" every Tuesday afternoon between 1pm and 4pm.

item.title: Mike Fisher hitting “The Long Road”
item.description: Introducing Mike Fisher - your co-host of "Greg Wilder's The Long Road". Mike joined Radio Mansfield in January 2023 and enjoys discovering new artists to bring you each week.

item.title: Meet our MaN – Murray Wallace
item.description: A very warm welcome to one of our newest presenters Murray Wallace. Murray's motivation to be a part of the Radio Mansfield team stems from a desire to be a part of the community and perhaps make a difference.

item.title: 80’s twists with Simone Boyd
item.description: Having been on air for just over six months, Simone Boyd loves the fact that music has the power to elicit memories of people, places and events.

item.title: Our volunteers – absolute legends!
item.description: Radio Mansfield would like to extend a huge thank you to our volunteers - we certainly could not do it without their commitment and enthusiasm.

item.title: Text us on 0499 654 967
item.description: Text our presenters on 0499 654 967 with feedback requests or just to say hello. Remember to include your name for an on-air mention!

item.description: Cindy MCLEIGH (Eildon) 29 October 2025: “I attended the celebration of Mansfield Community Radio 99.7FM’s 30 years on air on Saturday night. item.title: Mansfield Pottery Festival
item.description: Outside broadcast. Join us on Saturday for a feast of pottery, transforming the central median strip under the shady trees. The perfect setting to soak up the talent and creativity from potters from all over Australia. For more info about the festival go to www.mansfieldpotteryfestival.com.au Came and say hello and meet our great volunteers.

item.title: Mansfield Harmony Festival
item.description: Free Event Saturday 21st March, in the High St Median 11-4pm. Live music, foods of the world, cultural displays & arts and crafts. Celebrating the many cultures which make up the Mansfield Community. Radio Mansfield will be broadcasting live from the festival. Come and say hello to our fabulous volunteers.

item.title: We Want You
item.description: Come and join a great team of volunteers, become a member, become a presenter. We are always looking for new faces and voices to add to our team. Contact us via email: secretary@radiomansfield.org.au
